title: Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT)
description: Medicare coverage criteria for intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT). Covered for head and neck cancers, prostate carcinoma, or CNS tumors where 3D conformal radiation cannot deliver the prescribed dose without exceeding normal tissue tolerance of adjacent critical organs.

criteria.name: Head and Neck, Prostate, or CNS Malignancy Near Critical Organs
criteria.description: Biopsy-proven head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, or brain/spinal tumor located adjacent to critical dose-sensitive structures (spinal cord, brainstem, optic structures, salivary glands). Rectal and bladder dose sparing are addressed in dosimetric planning (CRIT-IMRT-02), not tumor proximity.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm clinical diagnosis qualifying for inverse-planned modulation based on critical dose-limiting neural and salivary structures
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Dosimetric Proof of 3D Conformal Inadequacy
criteria.description: Documented comparison confirming 3D conformal radiation would exceed safe dose constraints to parotid glands, rectum/bladder, or optic nerves.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Simple Palliative Bone Metastases Exclusion
criteria.description: IMRT requested for uncomplicated palliative irradiation of non-spinal bone metastases where 3D conformal or simple fields are standard.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude inverse-planned IMRT for simple palliative treatments
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD. Radiation therapy policies exist for SBRT (L35076) and SRT, but pure IMRT is governed under general radiation oncology benefit.
cms_reference.authority: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A)
cms_reference.citation: Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A); Medicare Benefit Policy Manual Chapter 15 § 80
